Messages.Author: Cartman
Messages.Body:
1)Vamp A plays Ancient Influence, noone blocks.
The referendum passes, but before it ends vamp B plays Delaying Tactics.
Can anyone else play A.I. again later?

2)My prey with 3 pool left played a Major boon on me. I bleed him for 3 with
Legal Manipulations, and I have 3 pool left too. My prey burns M.B. making
me loose 3 pool.
What happens?

Thanx

Messages.Author: reyda
Messages.Body:
Cartman wrote:
:: 1)Vamp A plays Ancient Influence, noone blocks.

:: The referendum passes, but before it ends vamp B plays Delaying
:: Tactics. Can anyone else play A.I. again later?

No. Once this vote has been called once, it is illegal to call it again,
even if the referenfum is cancelled because Only one Ancient influence can
be called in a game.

:: 2)My prey with 3 pool left played a Major boon on me. I bleed him

:: for 3 with Legal Manipulations, and I have 3 pool left too. My
:: prey burns M.B. making me loose 3 pool.
:: What happens?

your prey kills you. Your predator gains the usual 6 pool and one VP. If you
were only two players left, your prey wins the game =)

Messages.Author: LSJ



Because you only gain the pool if the bleed is successful.
Which means after the pool has been lost for the bleed.

bleed is successful."

Major Boon: "You may burn this card to have that Methuselah
burn pool instead of you when you are successfully bled."

has already been determined to be successful, which would mean
the pool had already been gained for Legal Manipulations. Or
at least that the two would go in the same timing window, and
therefore the acting Meth would go first?
